nature.kind_zh: 既有检查的可数化登记，不是新增检查

nature.derivation_zh: 十一道闸门的口径、当前读数与历史查获案例全部由包内既有文件推出：`changelog.md` 的逐版登记、`visual/assets/qa-proofing-record.json` 的 records 与 findings、`visual/assets/review-archive.json` 的三方审查发现、`manifest.json` 的文件条目、`metrics.json` 的复算登记、以及两个随包校验器的实际退出码。本文件不产生任何新主张，也不产生任何指标数值。
nature.derivation_en: Every gate definition, current reading and historical catch is derived from files already in this package: the version-by-version entries in `changelog.md`, the records and findings in `visual/assets/qa-proofing-record.json`, the three-way review findings in `visual/assets/review-archive.json`, the file entries in `manifest.json`, the recalculation entries in `metrics.json`, and the actual exit codes of the two shipped checkers. This file makes no new claim and produces no metric value.
nature.metrics_effect_zh: 无。本文件不产生任何指标数值；`metrics.json` 中十项待实测指标保持 unknown。
nature.metrics_effect_en: None. This file produces no metric value; the ten pending metrics in `metrics.json` stay unknown.
nature.honesty_rule_zh: `caught_real_defects` 只登记该闸门口径本身实际查获过的缺陷。口径本身未有查获案例的闸门，该字段为空数组并由 `caught_real_defects_status_zh` 写明「未有登记案例」；与该闸门相邻但不属其口径的历史修复登记在 `adjacent_registered_cases`，不计入查获数。
nature.honesty_rule_en: `caught_real_defects` lists only defects the gate's own criterion actually caught. Where the criterion has caught nothing, the array is empty and `caught_real_defects_status_en` says so; historical fixes adjacent to but outside the criterion sit in `adjacent_registered_cases` and are never counted as catches.

gates.caliber_note_zh: 口径注记（v8.5 登记）：本闸门判定的对象是嵌入的字体程序（`FontFile`／`FontFile2`／`FontFile3`），四册中此类条目只有 Source Han Sans SC 的三个子集。除此之外，打印管线还会写出 Type3 字体条目：Type3 不含任何字体程序，字形以 PDF 路径算子逐个写入页面，因而无法按「嵌入字体文件的许可」判定，本闸门原判据未覆盖该类。逐册清点 Type3 条目 A0 中文册 3 个、A0 英文册 0 个、A3 中文册 12 个、A3 英文册 5 个（2026-08-21 复点，见 PG-07-D2）；其 `FontDescriptor` 的 `FontName` 绝大多数指向上述思源黑体子集，唯 A3 中文册第 2 页的一个条目与第 15 页的两个条目（各只落一个字形，合计三处）指向 `PingFangSC-Regular`，即字号回退到 macOS 系统字体后由打印管线转为轮廓路径。该两条不构成字体文件再分发（无字体程序随包分发），但其描述符名称已越出本包已清权的 OFL 范围，本版如实登记为已知例外，处置待定：需重出 A3 中文册并把这两个字形补进思源黑体子集方可消除；当前工具链的字体子集步骤（`wp4b/mkfont.py` 与 `build/tokens.js`）在本机已缺失，无法在本版完成补字。
gates.caliber_note_en: Caliber note (registered in v8.5): this gate judges embedded font programs (`FontFile`, `FontFile2`, `FontFile3`), and the only such entries in the four books are the three Source Han Sans SC subsets. Beyond those, the print pipeline also emits Type3 font entries: a Type3 font carries no font program at all — its glyphs are written into the page as PDF path operators — so it cannot be judged by the licence of an embedded font file, and the gate's original criterion did not cover the class. Counted book by book, the Type3 entries are 3 in the Chinese A0 boards, 0 in the English A0 boards, 12 in the Chinese A3 book and 5 in the English A3 book (recounted 2026-08-21, see PG-07-D2). Almost all of their `FontDescriptor` `FontName` values point at the Source Han Sans SC subsets above; the exceptions are one entry on page 2 and two on page 15 of the Chinese A3 book (one drawn glyph each, three in all) naming `PingFangSC-Regular`, i.e. two characters that fell back to the macOS system face and were converted to outline paths by the print pipeline. Those two redistribute no font file (no font program ships), but the descriptor name lies outside this package's cleared OFL scope, so v8.5 registers them as a known exception with disposition pending: clearing it requires re-issuing the Chinese A3 book with those two glyphs added to the Source Han Sans subset, and the toolchain's font-subsetting step (`wp4b/mkfont.py` and `build/tokens.js`) is missing on this machine, so the gap could not be closed in this version.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 审计发现四册 PDF 自首版起，经浏览器打印管线的字体栈回退混入了未清权的系统字体子集——HelveticaNeue、Georgia、Menlo、STSongti-SC——与权利登记「仅嵌入思源黑体 OFL 子集」不符。这是一处真实的合规缺陷，不是排版瑕疵。
caught_real_defects.found_en: The audit found that since the first version all four PDFs had picked up uncleared system font subsets through the browser print pipeline's font-stack fallback — HelveticaNeue, Georgia, Menlo and STSongti-SC — contradicting the rights register's claim that only Source Han Sans OFL subsets were embedded. This was a genuine compliance defect, not a typesetting blemish.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 把全部生成器的字体声明钉死到思源黑体（衬线口号与等宽标签的视觉区分改由字重、字距与表格数字实现），四册重渲后经全册字体审计（遍历页面与 XObject 资源）确认零非 OFL 条目。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: Every generator's font declaration was pinned to Source Han Sans (the serif slogan and monospaced labels re-expressed through weight, tracking and tabular figures instead), and after re-rendering, a full-book audit walking pages and XObject resources confirmed zero non-OFL entries.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 本闸门 v8.9 复跑时发现 v8.5 登记的 Type3 清点自身有误：A3 中文册实为 12 个条目而非 11 个，漏计的正是第 2 页的一个 `PingFangSC-Regular` 条目，即已知例外应为三处而非两处。清点漏项使一处未清权字体名称长期未被登记。
caught_real_defects.found_en: Re-running this gate for v8.9 found the Type3 tally registered in v8.5 to be wrong in itself: the Chinese A3 book carries 12 entries, not 11, and the missing one is a `PingFangSC-Regular` entry on page 2 — so the known exception is three entries, not two. The undercount left one uncleared font name unregistered.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 口径注记按 2026-08-21 的逐页复点整体改写：四册 Type3 条目 3／0／12／5，`PingFangSC-Regular` 例外由两处更正为三处（第 2 页一处、第 15 页两处）。本版同时登记 A0 中文册第 1 页因补字而新增的一个思源黑体 Type3 条目（2 个改为 3 个），该条目仍在已清权的 OFL 范围内。处置去向不变：仍须重出 A3 中文册并补字方可消除三处例外。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The caliber note was rewritten against a page-by-page recount on 2026-08-21: Type3 entries 3/0/12/5 across the four books, and the `PingFangSC-Regular` exception corrected from two entries to three (one on page 2, two on page 15). The same revision registers the one additional Source Han Sans Type3 entry on page 1 of the Chinese A0 boards created by this version's supplementary glyph (2 becomes 3), which stays inside the cleared OFL scope. The disposal route is unchanged: the exception is removed only by re-issuing the Chinese A3 book with the glyphs subset in.

gates.name_zh: QA 记录条目自洽闸门
gates.checks_zh: `visual/assets/qa-proofing-record.json` 的四组记录 R1—R4：条目总数是否与文件自述一致、每条 `findings` 是否带级别与处理去向、每条局限是否如实在册、每条读数是否标注复测日期或引自既有登记。
gates.checks_en: The four record groups R1 to R4 in `visual/assets/qa-proofing-record.json`: whether the item total matches the file's own statement, whether every finding carries a severity and a disposition, whether every limitation is registered as fact, and whether every reading is dated or marked as carried over from an existing register.
gates.criterion_zh: 条目数与自述不符、findings 缺去向、或局限被省略，任一即失败；「本轮未重跑」的条目必须如实标注，不得以旧读数冒充新实测。
gates.criterion_en: A mismatch between the item total and the file's own statement, a finding without a disposition, or an omitted limitation each fail the gate; items not re-run in the current round must say so and may never pass an old reading off as fresh measurement.
gates.caliber_note_zh: 口径注记（v8.5 登记）：`qa-proofing-record.json` 的读数由一次性量测脚本产出（如条目 `tool_zh` 登记的「Node.js 结构分类比对脚本」），这些脚本不属于交付件、不随包分发；条目登记的是方法、工具类型、日期与逐项结果，读数因此按方法可复算，但本闸门不提供可直接重跑的随包命令（与 PG-10 登记 `reproduction_command` 的口径不同）。凡未随包分发量测脚本的读数，一律以「方案方自行执行的自查」计，不得读作第三方实测或可一键复现的机器结论。
gates.caliber_note_en: Caliber note (registered in v8.5): the readings in `qa-proofing-record.json` come from one-off measurement scripts (such as the "Node.js structural-classification comparison script" named in the entries' `tool_zh`), which are not deliverables and do not ship with the package. Each entry registers the method, the type of tool, the date and the item-by-item result, so a reading can be recomputed from the method, but this gate offers no ready-to-run command inside the package — unlike PG-10, which registers a `reproduction_command`. Any reading whose measuring script does not ship counts as a self-check run by the proposer, and must not be read as third-party measurement or as a one-command reproducible machine verdict.
gates.current_reading_zh: R1 六项 + R2 八项 + R3 十项 + R4 四项 = 28 项；findings 八条（两条已修复、两条复测确认已修复、四条观察项如实登记）；已知局限七条；本文件明示不产生任何指标数值。
gates.current_reading_en: R1 six plus R2 eight plus R3 ten plus R4 four equals 28 items; eight findings (two fixed, two confirmed fixed on re-test, four registered as observations); seven known limitations; the file states explicitly that it produces no metric value.
gates.superseded_reading_zh: 本闸门此前登记为 R4 五项、合计 29 项。R4-05「双态漫游成片完整性」随 v8.1 撤下双态漫游五件套一并删除（该轮同步改写了 R4 组标题），2026-08-18 复测 R4 组实测四项（R4-01 至 R4-04），故总项数由 29 降为 28。条目减少的原因是被测对象已移出本包，不是检查被省略；本闸门以当前读数为准。闸门名此前印作「QA 记录 29 项闸门」，因条目总数随被测对象增删而变，本轮改为不绑定条目数的「QA 记录条目自洽闸门」，判据未变。
gates.superseded_reading_en: This gate was previously registered at five R4 items and 29 in total. R4-05, the completeness check on the dual-state walk film, was deleted together with the five dual-state walk files withdrawn in v8.1 (that round also rewrote the R4 group title). Re-measured on 2026-08-18, the R4 group holds four items (R4-01 to R4-04), so the total falls from 29 to 28. The item was removed because the object it tested left the package, not because a check was dropped; this gate uses the current reading. The gate was previously named "QA record twenty-nine-item gate"; because the item total moves as tested objects enter and leave the package, it is renamed here to "QA record item-consistency gate", with no change to its criterion.

gates.name_zh: 两路独立盲审归档闸门
gates.checks_zh: `visual/assets/review-archive.json` 是否把本包宣称的「维护方实测 + 两路独立盲审」登记为可核对象：三方是否齐备、两路盲审是否运行于不同模型与运行时、审查期间是否互不知晓对方结论、每路是否带分级与发现摘要、至少一路是否带报告全文与内容哈希、独立性边界是否如实声明。
gates.checks_en: Whether `visual/assets/review-archive.json` turns the claimed maintainer-probes-plus-two-blind-reviews into a checkable object: all three parties present, the two blind reviews run on different models and runtimes, neither seeing the other's conclusions during review, each carrying a severity grading and findings summary, at least one carrying the full report text and its content hash, and the independence boundary stated as fact.
gates.criterion_zh: 缺任一路、缺分级、缺全文或哈希、或把委托方发起的审查描述为第三方机构认证，任一即失败。
gates.criterion_en: A missing track, a missing grading, a missing full text or hash, or describing a commissioned review as third-party institutional certification each fail the gate.
gates.current_reading_zh: 已归档一次专项审查 RV-SEB-2026-08-15（基线提交 4bf557874），三方齐备：维护方九组实测探针；盲审 A（Claude Opus 子代理，只读契约）阻断 3・高 6・中 6・低 8；盲审 B（GPT-5.6 Sol via Codex CLI，只读沙箱）阻断 2・高 5・中 6・低 2，带 `report_sha256` 与报告全文。独立性边界如实声明为「由本方案团队发起、委托并验收，不构成任何第三方机构认证」。
gates.current_reading_en: One dedicated review is archived, RV-SEB-2026-08-15 (baseline commit 4bf557874), with all three parties present: nine maintainer probe sets; blind review A (a Claude Opus subagent under a read-only contract) grading 3 blocking, 6 high, 6 medium, 8 low; blind review B (GPT-5.6 Sol via Codex CLI in a read-only sandbox) grading 2 blocking, 5 high, 6 medium, 2 low, carrying `report_sha256` and the full report text. The independence boundary is stated as fact: commissioned, run and accepted by this proposal's team, constituting no third-party institutional certification.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 盲审 A 与盲审 B 同时判为阻断级：SEB 规范只「建议采用」CC BY-SA 4.0 而从未实际授予，两个外部采用方在无有效许可状态下运行，规范却已主张下游署名义务。
caught_real_defects.found_en: Both blind reviews graded this as blocking: the SEB specification only recommended CC BY-SA 4.0 and had never actually granted it, so the two external adopters were operating without a valid licence while the specification already asserted downstream attribution duties.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 新增随包授予文件 `visual/assets/seb-license-grant.json`——著作权人授予声明加法定正文全文与重建哈希，文本著作权许可与机构托管两件事明确拆分，采用方许可依据即时成立。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: A grant file was added to the package, `visual/assets/seb-license-grant.json`, carrying the rightsholder's grant statement, the full statutory text and a rebuild hash, separating the copyright licence from institutional hosting so that adopters have an immediate licence basis.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 盲审 A 判定 FS-041「已修复」声称被实验证伪，回执缺自家 schema 十四项必填字段中的十三项，且历史版本引用无处解引用——采用方锁定引用的 v0.2 原文只存在于 git 历史。
caught_real_defects.found_en: Blind review A found the FS-041 claim of being fixed falsified by experiment, receipts missing thirteen of the fourteen fields their own schema requires, and historical version references with nowhere to dereference — the v0.2 text adopters had pinned existed only in git history.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 回执按 schema 重铸为一版一号，十三条失败样本逐条登记（含「修复本身违规」与许可缺陷）；v0.2.0／v0.3.0 规范快照按字节随包发布并登记上游提交号与内容哈希。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: Receipts were recast under the schema as one number per version with all thirteen failed samples registered individually (including a fix that itself violated the rule, and the licence defect); byte-exact v0.2.0 and v0.3.0 snapshots were shipped with upstream commit ids and content hashes.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 维护方九组探针查获：`chain-run` 无词表合格性校验、`includes` 词缀误伤合法角色词、缺 `decision` 块导致裸崩 TypeError、声明的来源文件缺失时静默跳过并打印与事实相反的说明。
caught_real_defects.found_en: The maintainer's nine probe sets caught a `chain-run` with no lexicon eligibility check, an `includes` affix match that wrongly rejected legitimate role words, a bare TypeError crash on a missing `decision` block, and a silent skip that printed a statement contrary to fact when a declared source file was absent.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 合格性判据升格进规范条文并由两实现共同执行；`SOURCE_MISMATCH` 由私有判定码升格为条文判据（声明不可读整次拒绝）；缺 `decision` 块改为组件级采用跳过并在输出中打印。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The eligibility criteria were raised into the specification text and enforced by both implementations; `SOURCE_MISMATCH` was promoted from a private code to a specified criterion that rejects the whole run when a declaration cannot be read; and a missing `decision` block became a component-level adoption skip printed in the output.

gates.checks_zh: 两个互不共享代码的随包校验器 `visual/assets/seb-tabletop-run.js` 与 `visual/assets/seb-op04-chain-run.js`，对同一套判据是否给出一致判定：逐条样例的判定与期望比对、判定码是否同出一张登记表、读数不符项计数、以及两者的退出码。
gates.checks_en: Whether the two shipped checkers that share no code — `visual/assets/seb-tabletop-run.js` and `visual/assets/seb-op04-chain-run.js` — reach the same verdicts under one criteria set: fixture verdicts compared against expectations, verdict codes drawn from one registered table, the count of disagreeing figures, and both exit codes.
gates.criterion_zh: 任一样例判定与期望不符、读数不符项大于 0、判定码不在规范登记表内、或任一退出码非 0，即失败；同一非法输入在两个实现下必须得到同一判定。（本判据自 v9.5 起由 visual/assets/seb-crosscheck-run.js 执行：该脚本把下列读数、码集双向一致与「同一非法输入同判」三事写成可执行断言，任一不成立即以退出码 1 结束。）
gates.criterion_en: Any fixture verdict differing from its expectation, any disagreeing figure, any verdict code outside the registered table, or a non-zero exit code fails the gate; the same illegal input must draw the same verdict from both implementations. (From v9.5 this criterion is executed by visual/assets/seb-crosscheck-run.js, which turns the readings below, the two-directional agreement of the code sets and the one-illegal-input-one-verdict promise into executable assertions and ends at exit code 1 where any of them does not hold.)
gates.current_reading_zh: node seb-tabletop-run.js 退出码 0，样例 62 条与期望 62／62 一致（通过 23、拒绝 39），汇总段另打印「条目总数复核 : 声明 62 · 实跑 62」；node seb-op04-chain-run.js 退出码 0，声明判定 4／4 与期望一致、读数不符项 0，其前置校验器摘录行为 62／62；node seb-crosscheck-run.js 退出码 0，断言不成立项 0——定点读数三组逐项相等，桌面校验器 40 个可发码、证据链复演器 23 个可发码与基准登记表 40 个登记码双向相等，五组非法输入（对照、删整张判定码登记表、闸门码改未登记码、基准截断为非法 JSON、删 node_schema 组件）两实现退出码逐组相等。三次运行均不写入 metrics.json。

caught_real_defects.found_en: This gate's own two promises were falsified by measurement, and the three sets of counts it registered had nothing executable behind them. The maintainer's internal adversarial audit of the two checkers applied forty-four mutations: with the whole verdict-code registry deleted the tabletop checker's output was byte-identical to a clean run at exit 0 while the chain replayer refused the same input at exit 2; with the baseline's level-gate code renamed to an unregistered value both implementations exited 0 and still reported all codes registered; one fixture fewer gave 59 of 59 at exit 0 and an empty set 0 of 0 at exit 0, as did deleting an archive row, emptying the selection checks and emptying the claim set; raising the archive's self-supplied tolerance to ten thousand metres let every figure be off by fifty metres and still report zero disagreements; and with a road missing from the geometry the replayer still printed that all five centreline lengths matched. caliber_notes.title_zh: 调色板 PNG 无损压缩基线（两批口径）
caliber_notes.title_en: Lossless compression baseline for palette PNGs (two batches)
caliber_notes.zh: 包内 43 件调色板 PNG 按落盘链路分两批，压缩基线不同，登记如下。B 批由 `pngquant` 加 `zopflipng -y --filters=0 -m` 配方产出（65-98、40-70、55-90 三档），v9.1 及更早已完成，无损档位无剩余余量。A 批由 Pillow `save(optimize=True)` 收尾，未过 zopflipng；Pillow 的启发式过滤器选择会对调色板索引做差分，对本类图属反向优化。v9.3 对全部 43 件重扫，命中 19 件，取其中收益不低于 6 KB 的 16 件按 `zopflipng -y --iterations=5 --filters=0` 无损重过滤，回收 379,628 字节。零损证据：16 件逐件以 `magick <f> -depth 8 rgba:-` 解码后比对像素 md5，改写前后 16／16 完全一致；原文件 chunk 序列为 IHDR／PLTE／IDAT…／IEND，无任何 ancillary chunk，输出 chunk 类型集合逐件一致；位深与调色板不变。本批因此不触发任何图版可读性读数的重测。对 v9.1 结论的更正：v9.1「图件再压一张」条登记的「抽样五张，四张零回收、一张仅回收 393 字节——历史批次已把无损熵编码用尽，该档位不再有可用余量」是抽样有偏的结论。该五张样本全部落在 B 批，即已由 zopflipng 配方收尾的文件，其零回收只说明 B 批已到底，不能外推到 A 批。按当前口径，正确表述是：无损档位对 B 批无余量，对 A 批当时尚有 380,094 字节余量；本版取用 379,628 字节，余 466 字节分布在三件收益低于 400 字节的文件上，不予取用。原条目按「已发布条目不重写」纪律保持原样，本注记为其更正登记。生成器同步：A 批中唯一在工具链内保有完整 PNG 落盘链路的是 `visual/assets/scene-fallback{,.en}.png`（`w88-fb/compose.py`），已同批追加同一条 zopflipng 后处理；其余 14 件的临时生成源按 `report/copyright_statement.md` C 类登记不随包提交，工具链内无对应脚本可同步。
caliber_notes.en: The package's 43 palette PNGs fall into two batches by the path that wrote them, on different compression baselines, registered here. Batch B comes from `pngquant` plus `zopflipng -y --filters=0 -m` (the 65-98, 40-70 and 55-90 recipes) and was completed at v9.1 or earlier; the lossless setting holds nothing further for it. Batch A was finished by Pillow `save(optimize=True)` and never passed through zopflipng; Pillow's heuristic filter choice differences palette indices, which for this class of image works against the encoder. v9.3 rescanned all 43, hit 19, and re-filtered losslessly the 16 whose gain reached 6 KB, with `zopflipng -y --iterations=5 --filters=0`, recovering 379,628 bytes. Zero-loss evidence: each of the 16 was decoded with `magick <f> -depth 8 rgba:-` and its pixel md5 compared before and after, 16/16 identical; the originals carry the chunk sequence IHDR/PLTE/IDAT…/IEND with no ancillary chunk, and the output chunk-type set matches file by file; bit depth and palette are untouched. No legibility reading is re-measured for this batch. Correction to the v9.1 conclusion: the v9.1 entry recorded that of five sampled plates four recovered nothing and one recovered 393 bytes, and concluded that earlier rounds had exhausted lossless entropy coding. That sample was biased: all five sat in Batch B, already finished by a zopflipng recipe, so their zero return says only that Batch B is exhausted and does not extend to Batch A.
